notes.title: All-In-One Sports 1.6.1 Update Notes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39627236/f92f8c362984ba560cdafe3e8188fbb13b7858c0.png

Hello players,
It’s been a while since our last update. Thank you so much for your patience and continued support!
The 1.6.1 update is now live, bringing exciting new content, improved gameplay mechanics, and important bug fixes.

Update Highlights

 New Game Mode: 3-Cushion Billiards
A challenging and strategic billiards mode for experienced players.

 Improved Bowling Physics
Enhanced realism in ball spin, friction, and pin collision.

 Global Matchmaking Server Selection
Choose from multiple regions such as Asia, North America, and Europe for smoother gameplay and better connectivity.

 Improved Ball Collision in Billiards
Fixed an issue where balls reacted before actual contact.

 Updated Match Start Rules
The starting player is now chosen randomly instead of always defaulting to Player 1.
This provides a more balanced and fair multiplayer experience.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where Four-Ball Billiards Level 5 could not progress.
 Fixed a bug where the support line remained visible after leveling up in billiards.


We’re committed to improving your experience with each update.
Enjoy the new content and stay tuned for more!

– Appnori Team

notes.title: All-In-One Sports 1.6.0 Update Announcement
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39627236/419ef49653c59a125136d28919e23d3a20facf9c.png

Hello, All-In-One Sports players!
We have released version 1.6.0 to improve your gameplay experience.
This update includes multiplayer improvements, adjustments and bug fixes for various sports, and new billiards DLC additions.

Update Details

Multiplayer Improvements

 Fixed an issue where the opponent's character would appear in an abnormal position if the player was outside the VR boundary before a multiplayer match started.


Soccer

 Improved controller responsiveness, making kicking the ball smoother and more accurate.


Table Tennis

 Fixed the ball position and grab animation appearing incorrectly on the opponent’s character in multiplayer matches.


Tennis

 Adjusted serve ball speed.
 Relaxed the camera movement restriction when the ball is sent far away from the opponent.
 Adjusted the force applied when hitting the ball.


Bowling

 Improved UI display.
 Adjusted the physics of bowling pins.


New Billiards DLC Added
Experience new and exciting billiards modes with our latest DLC!


 Four Ball Billiards: A new strategic billiards mode has been added.


Download the DLC now and enjoy a deeper billiards experience!

The update will be applied automatically, so please make sure you are playing the latest version.
We are committed to providing an even better sports experience for our players.
Thank you for your continued support!




Appnori. Team

notes.title: 1.4.1 Version Update Summary
notes.content:
Get Ready for the Ultimate VR Sports Experience!

We’re thrilled to announce the release of three brand-new sports in the latest DLC for All In One Sports VR! 
This DLC brings a whole new level of excitement to All In One Sports VR. 
Whether you crave the intense discipline of combat sports or the adrenaline rush of team-based play, we’ve got you covered!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39627236/b362201896a9fcbc967ffb7baeea4c540bb1341b.png

Each of these new sports will challenge you in unique ways, offering fresh, immersive experiences designed to push your skills and keep the adrenaline pumping. 
This isn’t just an update—it’s a major expansion that adds even more excitement and variety to your favorite VR sports game.



[olist]



 1. KungFu 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39627236/c849f18d19a66cb8b97e0cebeb077d51b825f0fd.png

Unleash your inner martial artist! 
Engage in intense sparring sessions, using real Kung Fu movements to block, deflect, and counter your opponent's attacks. 
Feel the precision and agility required as you train like a true master.



 2. Hockey 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39627236/13f0a529e31a4aae26f8982bb4049ceaea14a510.png

Challenge yourself to a fast-paced air hockey game. 
Use the VR controller to control your paddle with pinpoint accuracy to block, attack, and dominate your opponents. 
The winning dash is just one puck away!


 3. Soccer 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39627236/32f4317cdbf5bd25e1c98d106697834cf7cc2829.png

Step into the ultimate VR soccer experience! 
Whether you're dribbling past defenders, making that perfect pass, or shooting for goal, this mode brings the thrill of the pitch right to your living room with ultra-realistic physics and immersive gameplay.

[/olist]

notes.title: 1.3.0 Version Update!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39627236/efdb330b591d42be15eef7d4eb953cbbab7e26b3.jpg

1.3.0 Version Update!!

Hello, dear players!

We are excited to bring you a brand new update that will make your gaming experience even more diverse and enjoyable. In this update, we have added amazing Cosmetics for the tools and balls you need to play the game!

General Improvements


Matching System Improvements
Reduced Random Matching Wait Time
If the wait time for random matching becomes too long, the system will now automatically match you with an AI opponent. Enjoy faster matchmaking for a seamless gaming experience.

Timeout Loss Penalty
Players will automatically be considered defeated if they exceed the time limit twice during a game. This ensures smooth and fair gameplay.

New Tool Cosmetics
Achieve various milestones in each category and earn new cosmetics! Enjoy a more exciting gameplay experience.
Equip the new Cosmetics and show off your amazing style in the game!

examples:
Table Tennis: Score 100 points with smashes
Boxing: Knock down opponents 100 times
Archery: Win 10 shoot-offs

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39627236/e71078c3eac1fbdf05213b5fcf0d61636a30fe3f.png

Spectator Cheering Tools Update
We have added two new cheering tools for spectators: the Lightsaber and Fireworks. Enhance your spectator mode experience by using these diverse cheering tools to show your support and excitement!



Specific Game Updates


Table Tennis
Rally Scoring Rule Change
During a rally, if the opponent hits the ball and it does not hit the table but you return it, the opponent will lose the point.
Serve Spin Adjustment
The spin strength of serves has been reduced by 50%, making serves easier to handle.

Badminton
Serve Rule Adjustment
Previously, you had to hold the shuttlecock before serving, but now you can serve without holding it, allowing for more dynamic play.

Baseball
Changed the pitching mechanics.

Darts
Added a rule where a player loses if they timeout twice in a multiplayer game.

Billiards

Removed the UI that shows ball-related information to make multiplayer games more challenging.
Fixed the issue with the cue ball's hit point location.
Restored the missing trackpad movements.
Added a rule where a player loses if they timeout twice in a multiplayer game.


Boxing

Added a vibration animation when the health bar decreases.
Improved the camera tracking of the health bar for smoother movement.




We strive to provide a more enjoyable and seamless gaming experience by incorporating your feedback. Discover the new features and improvements in this update!

Thank you.

[ Appnori Inc. ]

We've added several new features and made improvements to existing ones. Please see the details below.

Major Updates

Spectator Mode Added
You can now watch ongoing multiplayer matches in real-time. Enjoy spectating your friends' or other players' games!

A new feature allows you to check your recent game history. Easily review which matches you've played and your performance in them.

The server selection UI has been removed and all servers have been integrated. Enjoy faster and more convenient multiplayer matchmaking.

[olist]

The trophy feature in the lobby has been improved. Check out the new look of your trophies!

The wait time for random multiplayer matchmaking has been removed, allowing you to start games more quickly.

We always value your feedback and strive to provide a better gaming environment. We hope this update enhances your gaming experience even further. As always, we welcome your opinions and suggestions.

notes.title: Patch Notes V_0.7.2 / BN 10
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39627236/3af30964171cafb041ef979e9e88c96aac565e98.png

Hello, everyone.

From Now ! Table Tennis multiplayer is eligible !
Enjoy ping-pong with your friend or family.
And there was an update on baseball. Several details have also been patched.
Please refer to the details section.
Thank you.



V_0.7.2 Update / BN10

Common issue

 Depending on the device, the position of hand modeling has been modified to be customized.
 The position and orientation of the bat or racket have been modified.


Baseball

 Modified the balance so that user can play the home run mode game longer.
 Added a home run mode item. (The ball-shaped item reduces one out counter. Life +1)
 Added strike zone area seen when pitching in league mode.
 Modified the balance of hitting in league mode.
 The Fire Bat has been modified to make a home-run easier.



Dart

 Modified hand animation and dart default position.


Ping-pong

 Multiplayer mode has been added.
 The physical logic of Ping-pong has been modified.

notes.title: Patch Notes V_0.6.1 / BN 7
notes.content:
Hello, everyone.

completed the patch for the things that need to be corrected urgently.

Golf

  corrected the problem that the golf club does not change when using Oculus Quest 2 on Virtual Desktop.


Bowling

  The bowling billboard has been changed.
  'how to play' has added a notice that the ball can be rotated.

notes.title: Patch Notes V_0.6.0 / BN 6
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39627236/f77375b8e85ae8dc4abb5d9737f20ce7bef97d50.png

Hello, everyone.

Some updates have been made on baseball and bowling. You can enjoy the game even more by adding fire bat items in baseball. And Several bugs have been fixed in bowling.

Thank you.



V_0.6.0 Update / BN6


Bowling

 modified it to throw the bowling ball again when it accidentally be dropped.
 modified it to prevent throwing the ball after time is over in multiplayer.



Baseball

  Adjusted the overall balance for the single league mode.
  Added Fire Bat by hitters in single league and multiplayer mode.
[olist]
 The fire bat is a powerful item that can counter the pitcher's fireball.
 Fire Bat can be used 1 time in Single mode and 3 times in Multi mode.
[/olist]
  Added Fire Bat, X2, and X3 bonuses to the single home run derby mode.

notes.title: Patch Notes V_0.5.0 / BN 5
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39627236/7dd2de4517d48ca1113e7927a63c0315f59bb316.png

Hello, everyone.

Finally, you can choose the language you want in the game and play it. A total of 13 languages are provided and can be changed through the Settings UI.

You can now play in a total of 9 holes. Now you can enjoy golf in more diverse environments.

Thank you.


V_0.5.0 Update / BN5


Common issue

 Language added successfully. There are 13 languages in total.
[olist]

 English
 한국어
 日本語
 español
 Deutsch
 Português
 русский язык
 Italiano
 język polski
 Türkçe
 简体中文
 繁體中文
 Français
[/olist]


Golf

  Golf halls have been added. You can now play in a total of 9 holes.
  Golf has been improved so that it can be played smoothly even with lower specifications.
  Changed the UI location of golf.
  Changed the effect of the ball in golf.
  Corrected the problem that several golf clubs appear intermittently in golf multiplayer.
  Changed the arrow on the other person's ball so that it is invisible when multiplayer.

notes.title: Patch Notes V_0.4.0 / BN 4
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39627236/ffd21bb0c702225c0ec89dcc03868c0e0040d183.png

Hello, everyone.

The biggest change in this update is that you can choose the server you want. Now you can enjoy multi-game with friends who are far away.

Also we fixed some problems in baseball. Please check the phrase below for more details!
See you in the next update.

Thank you.


V_0.4.0 Update / BN4


Common issue

 Sever selection option added
 You can choose the best server according to the local server status.


Baseball

  Improved pitcher pitching physics.
  An arrow was added over the runners' heads to make it easier to recognize.
  Added UI for Hit By Pitch, Fourball, Strike Out.
  Scoreboard UI added .
  Improved the batter's artificial intelligence in SBO single mode.
  Modified the hitting power In reality and improved the physics .

notes.title: Patch Notes V_0.3.0 / BN 3
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39627236/deb1d02dcb08d68fb6c369a8f7040dbc32f4ddc4.png

Hello, everyone.

The biggest change in this update is the availability of baseball multiplayer. 
You can enjoy baseball with other player from now on. Please have fun!

There are also some updates in basketball, archery, darts, and boxing.
We improved the setting UI to make it easy to access, and included image icons for anyone to understand without language barriers.

See you in the next update.
Thank you.



V_0.3.0 Update / BN3


Common issue

 Added image icons in setting UI.
 Setting UI type has changed . (slides > page)


Lobby

 Setting UI button has been added in front of the lobby table. (next to game shutdown button)
 The order of sports figures in the lobby has been slightly changed.


Archery

 Archery's ' One Arrow Shoot Off ' rule is applied.
 ' Shoot Off' is a rule that determines the victory by the score of the last one shot when the score is tied up through the 3rd round.


Baseball

 Added baseball multiplayer mode.
[olist]
 It starts at the beginning of the seventh inning and runs until the end of the ninth inning.
[/olist]
 Moved the betting position slightly forward.
 Reduced the number of fireballs from 5 to 3.
 Improved pitching accuracy.


Basketball

 The way basketball plays has been changed.
[olist]
 From 30 seconds, the time decreases by 5 seconds for every 3 movements.
 Added a buzzer bitter.
 Previous basketball records have been reset.
[/olist]
 Electronic display panel location has been changed.
 Added electronic display to check scored points.


Boxing

 Increased punch hit accuracy.
 The points were subdivided according to force, speed and accuracy.


Dart

 Increased the size of the dart target.
 Improved pitching accuracy.

notes.title: Patch Notes V_0.2.0
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39627236/2b67e625851852e24119a10bc83eeaeec74e01f9.png

Hello, everyone.
It's our Third update.
Left-handed mode, which was requested by many users, has been added. It can be selected in the Setting UI.
A multiplayer voice has been added. Now enjoy the conversation!

We will come back to you at the next update.
Thank you.



V_0.2.0 Update


Common issue

 Added 'left-handed mode'. You can select your right/left hand to play.
 A Photon voice has been added. You can talk with opponents in multiplayer.


Lobby

 The description of 'Friend Mode' has been modified.
 The current version is displayed on the lobby floor.


Badminton

 Modified the sound and effect when the user hits the shuttlecock in multiplayer.


Baseball

 It changed from one inning to three innings.
 Batter's hand position has been changed.


Bowling

 Fixed the issue that the bowling ball falls into the gutter line too easily.
 Fixed the issue of bowling ball rotating too much.
 Added bowling leaderboard. [Initialized quarterly.]


Billiards

 The length of the hint line has been shortened during multiplayer.


Dart

 Thrower's hand position has been changed.
 Modified to be thrown more naturally.

notes.title: Patch Notes V_0.1.2_B
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39627236/3c8cbd1f9e0fcf4da74870a6e9a3acc6721ffd9d.png

Hello, everyone.
It's our second update. 
Mainly we've dded Setting UI to control sound and haptic of the controller. 
Also Badminton and Boxing physics have been changed to make it easier to hit the target. 

We will try to meet your needs with continuous updates.
Thank you.


V_0.1.2 Update


Common issue

 Added UI to control sound and haptic. You can adjust it in the lobby and in-game menu buttons.
 The game Achievement Text in German, Spanish, and Russian were changed more naturally.


Lobby

 Added the Settings Control UI next to the ranking board.


Badminton

 fixed the issue of flying in a different direction from the intended direction when hitting the shuttlecock.


Table tennis(Ping-Pong)

 changed the size of the ping pong club smaller. 


Boxing

 Modified to increase the hit rate of hook punches in boxing.


Billiards

 fixed the problem that my ball is not set after the brake shot in multiplayer.


Golf

 fixed the problem of black screen when there is a network delay in golf multiplayer.

notes.title: Patch Notes V_0.1.1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39627236/9347251f8bede32eb137f8d5566d7aba93906c5b.png

Hello, everyone.
We have checked your opinions through discussion pages and reviews since the game was released.  Some issues require more time to fix, so please wait a little longer..
We're going to fix those issues through regular updates.

Thank you.

V_0.1.1 Update

Common issue

 Fixed a bug that the other person's cloth(top) is being printed incorrectly in Multiplayer.
 Fixed a bug that changed gender does applied after changing character's gender in customization.
 Fixed a bug that characters looks white when network connectivity is delayed.
 Fixed a bug that the range can not be recognized when starting a game away from the center.


Lobby

 The language of the achievements UI in the lobby has been localized in 10 lanquages.
 Fixed a bug that game quick start button does not work by touching.
 Fixed a bug that Backward button in Matching UI is not working when network delay occurs.
 Improved frames by optimizing lobby resources.


Archery

 'Start' voice was removed at game start.
 The level of difficulty of archery has been raised.
[olist]
 The fluctuation of wind strength has increased.
 The change in wind direction has intensified.
[/olist]

Badminton

 'Start' voice was removed at game start.
 Fixed a bug that the shuttlecock can not be hit due to the network delay in Multiplayer.
 Fixed a bug of shuttlecock's bouncing off when it hit the net.
 Changed the power of shuttlecock to fly a little harder when the racket hits it.
 

Bowling

 'Start' voice was removed at game start.
 Fixed a bug that the bowling balls disappeared due to network delays.
 The weight of the ball was fixed to be constant.

Basketball

 'Start' voice was removed at game start.
 Fixed a bug of net Cloth being weird.(On the next move)

Baseball

 Changed the range so that the ball can be pitched in a wider space.
